release_read.basis: Q3 XDEMVY net sales $194.6m (+64% YoY, +11.9% QoQ) beat the $183.9m Benzinga consensus by ~5.8%, refuting the Culper 'miss guidance' leg; H1+Q3 = $513.9m already makes the unchanged-looking $685-705m guide imply a Q4 decline, so the street's FY moves up. Tempered by no explicit guide raise in the release, a history of selling beats, and the Alkeus/PIPE unlock inside the window; EPS (-$14.40) is IPR&D-driven ($632m) and not the line.
